fontAndBidiEvidence.headlineShapingVerdict: Contextual joins, dots, hamzas, and the inspected selective diacritics are intact in the large Ghroob text. No disconnected headline glyphs were observed.
fontAndBidiEvidence.systemicFailure: The shared .micro role declares the Latin Ranclo face before Arial. fontAndBidiEvidence.documentLanguageFinding: The generated shell declares html lang=en while Arabic is applied only on the inner main element. The inner element is RTL, but the shell must be corrected to lang=ar and dir=rtl for Arabic exports.
fontAndBidiEvidence.counterFinding: Carousel counters resolve visually as ٣ / ١, ٣ / ٢, and ٣ / ٣. A right-to-left reader can infer current/total from the rightmost number, but the run is not explicitly isolated and remains exporter-dependent; use a tested directional island or the unambiguous wording ١ من ٣, ٢ من ٣, ٣ من ٣.

crossAssetLanguageVerdict.diacritics: Selective marks on سياقٍ, أدلّتها, قراراً, حدّد, سمِّ, حدٍّ, and بشري are visible and generally well formed. Selective vocalization should also disambiguate تُصلِح and تُسلِّم if those verbs remain.
crossAssetLanguageVerdict.lineBreaks: 01, 09, 10, and 11 use authored breaks. 02 strands وحدها as an orphan; 04 separates the unvocalized verb from its object and creates a temporary wrong reading.
crossAssetLanguageVerdict.punctuationAndNumerals: Arabic question marks and Arabic-Indic digits are used. The carousel fractions require explicit bidi isolation. The centered dot is acceptable as a metadata separator but is overused in tiny fallback labels.
crossAssetLanguageVerdict.regionalAuthority: The voice is formal Modern Standard Arabic and avoids decorative regional stereotypes. Authority drops whenever an English-only evidence line carries meaning that the Arabic version omits, most clearly in 03.
